definitions.ask: Should Ctrl+N / Ctrl+P wrap around at the ends of the emoji results?
definitions.why: Command Mode, the copy card, and the bank Category card all wrap Ctrl+N/P

choices.label: Ctrl+N on the last emoji lands on the first, and Ctrl+P on the first lands on the last
Ctrl+N and Ctrl+P stop on the first and last emoji, like the arrow keys
